notes.content:

notes.title: FULL V2.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Greetings, Community! 🎮[/b]

🚀[b]V2 update with all the features from our roadmap is finally here![/b]🚀

[h2]A big thank you to all of you for your fantastic ideas and valuable feedback![/h2]

[b]Update will work with your old saves![/b]

[h3]List of new features:[/h3]

[list]
[*]🧑[b]Character Customizator:[/b]

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMHhpZnp2Ym9nanFlZmRnbGFiMjJna2dnOWNidDdvNWduczY0ZGdwdSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xwsDDHMi3Jy0zVT4Jh/giphy.gif[/img]

Create your own character and leave your mark on the NYC scene!

[*]🚗[b]Car Jobs:[/b]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNmxpcDUwN2FkZzh2azE5dDhlOXl2dm03bXRwaG5mZzlpeGIweDBmYyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/qe7VsY1JFGhV3jHEIk/giphy.gif[/img]

You will be hired to steal a car.

After you accept this task, the [color=#d43737]CAR ICON[/color] will appear in different places at different times.
If you arrive at the location on time, you will be tasked with opening the lock.

[*]🎯[b]Hit Jobs:[/b]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2t5Nzl1YWpuNnhhaGEyejYzdTd1aXZucmFqdzJsY2FxeXZxeGY1ZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/F42Ml8bQzVPWDzw4D3/giphy.gif[/img]

You will be hired to eleminate target.

Once you accept this task, the [color=#d43737]TARGET ICON[/color] will appear in different places at different times.
If you arrive at the location on time, you will face the enem

[*]📦[b]DeliveryJobs:[/b]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNm12cGtwNTAxb3hkbmFvYXJ1ZTBvdG5yenRsZjQzbjV6emJoanZ3NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JAGDzaPIvg6JWFV4lP/giphy.gif[/img]

You will be hired to deliver a package to another city.

If you get there on time, you will be paid for your work.

[*]💲[b]Trade deals negotiations💲:[/b]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeHVrNDZncm44Zjk3Mzd5ZngwbWo5dTlxd215d3h1ZmZrcjFreGVrNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xF1uaEtwwkJt14LSSE/giphy.gif[/img]

Sometimes the [color=#FFD700]TRADE DEAL[/color] price will be negotiable.

Negotiation is handled through a mini game.

A correct stop of [color=gold]DOLLAR SIGN[/color] will improve the price, an incorrect stop will make it worse.

[*]🏢[b]Buying bulidings for rent🏢:[/b]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExc2MzaTdhNnNjdTZhOTlyNGRrNTNwcjJ5eDE0czZrNG9yNGJpeWN4ZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/8nF6T7Nyi6lferXUo8/giphy.gif[/img]

In addition to PROPERTIES, which are businesses you can run, you can now invest your hard-earned [color=#00ff8d]BANK MONEY[/color] to buy buildings that will provide you with legitimate income every day. 

By buying upgrades, you can increase the income from rent of your buildings.

The buildings can be found on the map.

[*]🚨[b]SET-UP Deals🚨:[/b]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZHBxOGQyNm5vMmk0YnFyamxqZGdyYmV5dG51c3g1ZHc3NXpzM2c1OSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/MSEkO9cTBRUC9vTCEG/giphy.gif[/img]

Sometimes [color=#FFD700]TRADE DEAL[/color] is police set-up.

To escape the SET-UP, you must beat the Quick Time Event Game and try to press the correct button when shown.

Three correct hits in a row will make you escape the ambush, otherwise you will be fighting DTF Agents.

[*]👮[b]Police Street Raids👮:[/b]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZTdub3Z0ZmRoYnpxNmR2cmRoNzExdjR2NGcxcWltb2trd3ZlNGNzcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/GJFuTjzcdWqAuoYoi1/giphy.gif[/img]

The police are keeping an eye on your moves on the street.

When they have the opportunity they will try to raid your street activities.

When you hire [color=#d43737]DIRTY COP[/color], you will be warned of a police raid and have a chance to organize a [color=#d43737]HIDEOUT[/color].

A police raid will result in the stop of [color=#ffa700]STREET[/color] income for [color=#d43737]3 days[/color].

[*]✈️🚁[b]Helicopter and Private Jet:[/b]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdnplYWh4N2lrNGVma3F4dXFlcGdtcnh1amp5dHh3ZHJjdmw4c3g4ZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/KbXuiejYIJB48drvRW/giphy.gif[/img]

Now you can buy a helicopter and a private jet.

With the helicopter, you will be able to travel across the country without worrying about police stops. With the private jet, you can enjoy quick city-to-city travel.

[*]🌟[b]New content:[/b]

Update comes with:
[list]
[*]🚗 New Vehicles
[*]💍 Fresh Pawn Shop Items
[*]🏠 Additional Properties
[*]🏭 Additional Street Facilities
[*]🔫 New Weapons
[*]🔄 New Random Events

[/list][/list]

[h3][b]If you enjoy the game and have the time, leaving a review would be a big help for PUSHER![/b][/h3]

[b]🌟 Wishing You an Incredible Day! 🎉[/b]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3]💬Join the Conversation!💬[/h3]

If you have any questions, suggestions, or  ideas about the game, we invite you to be a part of our  Discord community.

👉[url=https://discord.com/invite/aAwxqpWDg3]Join our discord server[/url]

notes.title: 🚨Game Update Roadmap🚨
notes.content:
[h3]I would like to thank everyone for their support and good reaction to the game![/h3]

[b]Special thanks[/b] for the ideas from community member [b][i]@TBSuzuka,[/i][/b] who put his mind to it!

Each new feature will be released separately to shorten the wait time for the full list of updates.

[h3]Here's a list of new features that will be added in an upcoming updates:[/h3] 

[olist]
[*] [b]Character Creation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make you own story!:
[i]You will be able to create your own character. Put your mark on the NY scene![/i]
[/list]

[*] [b]New ways to make money:[/b]
[list]
[*]Jobs:
[i]Deliver mysterious package from NY to Las Vegas or steal a car for order! [/i]
[*]Rents:
[i]Now you can buy and rent properties on the map. Upgrade them to make more profit.[/i]
[/list]

[*] [b]Negotiations mini-game:[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes deals trigger a negotiation price mini-game:
[i]Customers want to negotiate the prices - depending on the results of the mini-game, prices may go up or down.[/i]
[/list]

[*] [b]More Police activity:[/b]
[list]
[*] Set-up Deals:
[i]Sometimes deals sound to good to be truth - It’s a SET UP! - Police can set you up with suspiciously beneficial deal - you must be vigilant and don't get caught. SET-UP deals trigger  a mini-game - win gives you an escape from the situation and loss starts a fight with agents.[/i]
[*]Street Raids:
[i]The police will be able to raid your street business - they can detain your team members and close your street facilities. If you have corrupt cops on your payroll.- they will give you a tip beforehand so you can prepare.[/i]
[/list]

[*][b]More content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New items to buy:
[*] New cars, guns, planes, mansions, boat and even animals!
[*] New types of properties and facilities
[*] More custom events
[/list]

[/olist]

[h3]But we don't stop there! If you have any questions, suggestions, or ideas about the game, don't hesitate to join our Discord server![/h3]

[h2][url=https://discord.com/invite/aAwxqpWDg3]Join our discord server[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Achievements and Leaderboard Update!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

[b]PUSHER Drug Tycoon[/b] is now compatible with Steam functions, bringing you even more challenge in the game!

[b]1. Unlock 100 Achievements:[/b]
Are you ready for a challenge? We've added 100 unique achievements for you to unlock as you progress through the game.

[b]2. Leaderboards:[/b]
After 30 of game days, we'll calculate your score and rank you on the global leaderboard. Can you climb to the #1 spot and be recognized as the ultimate PUSHER?

[b]Stay Updated! Something Special is Coming:[/b]

As we approach the near release, we have something special for our players! We appreciate your support, and this surprise is our way of saying thank you. Keep an eye on our community for updates!
